These fixtures and the generator in `../support.rs` are original synthetic test
signals, dedicated to the public domain under CC0-1.0. They contain no recorded
music. `pcm16-mono.wav` is 10 ms of a 440 Hz sine at 48 kHz. The JSON beat grid
is synthetic ground truth. The duplicate fixture intentionally violates the
strictly increasing event contract. Larger DSP fixtures are generated in temp
directories by tests; no private music is required or uploaded.
